prompt_review.missing_general_clarity: The operation guide explains group setters and existing-room edits but does not explicitly distinguish per-stay room counts from a trip-wide pool or forbid invented one-person room capacities.
prompt_review.proposed_general_addendum: Conflicts are incompatible CURRENT user facts or affected saved facts, not missing or unsupported information. An unknown destination, search coverage, availability or room capacity is not by itself a contradiction. A requested room count applies separately to EACH stay; room ordinals and IDs are local to that stay, not a trip-wide room pool. Several travelers may share a room. A complete explicit assignment that keeps separate families apart is compatible when its per-stay room count is sufficient; do not invent a supplier capacity or a one-person-per-room rule. Keep all explicit cities, dates and scoped constraints in proposed operations even if another field needs clarification. Retain genuine conflicts; known independent proposals may be returned for SERVER REVIEW, never described as saved or executed.
prompt_review.replace_conflicting_existing_instruction: The old instruction to return conflicts and NO operations must be reconciled with review-only partial proposals. Do not append contradictory instructions.

policy_boundary: Do not blanket-clear model conflicts merely because the extracted batch is schema-valid or operation_conflicts is empty: the model may have omitted one side of a real contradiction.
Do not synthesize the missing multi-city stays/dates/breakfast using an unqualified case-specific regex.
Keep raw/checked proposals as uncommitted review evidence. Only a separately tested proof or actual improved extraction may change the outcome.
Unknown coverage or capacity belongs to clarification/tool validation, not an invented contradiction.
